title: Knowledge Graph declaration
description: Information kept as files in a repository: things, and the named relations between them. It is declared by one file at its root, `<name>.json`, which gives its name and lists its Subgraphs. This schema is the shape of that declaration, and its `$defs` define every term bootstrap uses.

name.description: The Knowledge Graph's name. The declaration file is `<name>.json`.

id.description: The Subgraph's name, unique within its Knowledge Graph.

path.description: The directory, relative to the declaration.

items.description: A named directory of a Knowledge Graph, declared with the Graph Kind or Kinds it holds. A Knowledge Graph has zero or more.

src.description: The file, relative to the declaration.

role.description: The part the file plays, such as `instance-readme`.

items.description: A single file a Knowledge Graph declares as its own, together with the part it plays, such as its README.

KnowledgeGraph.title: KnowledgeGraph
KnowledgeGraph.description: Information kept as files in a repository: things, and the named relations between them. It is declared by one file at its root, `<name>.json`, which gives its name and lists its Subgraphs.

Subgraph.title: Subgraph
Subgraph.description: A named directory of a Knowledge Graph, declared with the Graph Kind or Kinds it holds. A Knowledge Graph has zero or more.

GraphKind.title: GraphKind
GraphKind.description: What a Subgraph holds, such as skills, processes or schemas. A reader matches on it to decide whether to look inside.

Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A single file a Knowledge Graph declares as its own, together with the part it plays, such as its README.

Harness.title: Harness
Harness.description: What an Actor uses to work with a Knowledge Graph: Skills, Processes, Roles and Tools. A Harness is itself a Knowledge Graph, declared the same way; bootstrap is the first Harness.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: A participant, whether a person, an agent or a program, that takes a Role in each Process it takes part in.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: The part an Actor plays in a Process. A Process diagram draws each Role as one lane, and a Role carries the Skills its lane needs.

Process.title: Process
Process.description: A diagram of the steps, decisions and order of some work, with one lane per Role. It is written in Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN), a standard diagram format, in a `.bpmn` file.

ProcessNode.title: ProcessNode
ProcessNode.description: One element of a Process: a step, a decision, a start or an end.

SequenceFlow.title: SequenceFlow
SequenceFlow.description: An arrow in a Process, from one Process Node to the next.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: Written instructions an Actor follows to carry out one step of a Process, in a `.md` file.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: A program an Actor calls to carry out a step. A Harness may declare Tools; bootstrap declares none, because it runs nothing.
